ticket: W1-06 — GitHub App queued-sync revocation gapfill
goal: Close GAP-4 by enforcing the GitHub installation's current tenant binding and active state when the BullMQ ownership-sync worker begins a queued job, before any provider call, token mint, repository resolution, or graph write.

acceptanceCriteria.text: (GAP-4) A queued GitHub sync whose installation resolves as revoked, suspended, unknown, or bound to a different organization returns the existing ignored result before provider resolution, token mint, repository resolution, or graph write.
(GAP-4) A queued GitHub sync whose installation is active and bound to the envelope's server-derived organization continues through the existing provider, repository, and graph path unchanged.

edgeCases.text: (GAP-4) A missing, non-decimal, non-positive, or greater-than-safe-integer GitHub installation ID fails closed as ignored and does not invoke the installation resolver or downstream dependencies.
(GAP-4) A non-GitHub provider event remains provider-agnostic and does not invoke the GitHub installation resolver.
(GAP-4) Installation resolution errors propagate so BullMQ can retry rather than treating an unavailable security decision as an allowed or acknowledged sync.
